title: Mel Powell's tuberculosis and teaching
summary: Powell also got TB; Sauter says they were never friends.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: He was on a plane and he had a hemorrhage on a plane. Mel Powell was in that too; who knows if that didn't kick off Mel Powell.
Yes. That's why he became a teacher.

the Army period and went back to Yale. He married that actress--do you remember? He was kind of into the coast and then he got the TB and he went to Connecticut to cure it. I think it was after that that he decided to go to Yale. He never was a friend of mine.
No. He wasn't an enemy; he just wasn't a friend. I don't know why.
Just something of a personality clash?
No, I think that nothing brought us together. I knew him at a distance, but we never really sat down and talked.
He was a few years younger than you?
Oh, yes. He also came just before I got sick; that might have been another reason. He came in the autumn of '41, and I got sick
